summary: Forklift handling rebuilt as path kinematics with a physical speed profile (no stop-and-go per key, no turning on the spot or sideways sliding, forks enter real pallet pockets, load rigidly on the carriage, wheels roll and steer, mast tilts); new procedural forklift, workers, tractor cab and spinning truck wheels; scanned CC0 materials; contact grounding; verified on the iOS simulator in day and night with matched cameras.
changed_files: ios/Salini/AtelierMotion.swift (new): AtelierPath (lines + zero-end-curvature quintic Béziers, arclength, signed curvature), AtelierDrive (forward/backward speed profile: acceleration, lateral and steer-rate limits, slow zones; aligned or fitted into phase windows)

ios/Salini/ShippingAtelierScene.swift: AtelierTimeline rewritten (front-axle paths, 48→68 s cycle phases, rear-wheel steering, mast tilt, odometer, speed; truck departs 0.6 s after the forks clear the trailer); AtelierPose gains steer/tilt/odometer/speed; specs M_Cabinet/M_PipeWater/M_Strap, M_Frame graphite

ios/Salini/RealityAtelierScene.swift: mast/carriage/wheel transforms, load on the carriage chain (clamped to the floor), truck wheels spin with travel, contact shadows, trailer cutaway incl. curtain straps, exposure −1.25
ios/Salini/RealityAtelier.swift: QA launch args (-shipping-atelier-play, -shipping-atelier-speed, -reality-select, -reality-zone, -reality-scale, -reality-azimuth, -reality-perf frame-pacing report)
ios/tools/insight_poc/atelier_models.py (new): procedural forklift (separate mast pivot, carriage, tapered forks, four wheels), Skin-modifier workers (stand/inspect/walk/seated), tractor cab

ios/tools/insight_poc/build_atelier_kit.py: pallets with fork pockets, staging off the route, people v2, cab + wheel groups, origins/parents for moving parts, scanned materials (SCANS), provenance for ambientCG, facade lettering, straps material
ios/Salini/InsightAssets/* (kit16, 50 MB): USD kit, re-baked GI/AO, day+night probes, textures
motion_diagnosis: Baseline: piecewise smoothstep between keys → the forklift stopped at every key (speed 0 at 15 keys per cycle)
Heading interpolated separately from position → turning on the spot while translating (sideways crab), e.g. 13.5–15.5 s
Pallet stringers ran across the fork direction → forks passed through wood
Wheels/mast rigid; batch positioned independently from the carriage

motion_measurements_timeline.note: Measured over 4 cycles at 10 Hz by the test harness; enforced in testDrivingIsKinematicallyConsistent / testRouteClearsTheHallObstacles

sources_licenses: ambientCG CC0 1.0 (docs.ambientcg.com/license): Concrete016, Concrete034, Metal027, Metal040, Metal011, Rubber004, Wood061, Cardboard002 — used; Plastic013A downloaded, not used
Poly Haven CC0 assets as before (ASSETS.json)
The 3dassets.dev forklift + driver GLBs are no longer used (replaced by our procedural model)
decisions: Procedural forklift instead of a downloaded model: needed separate mast/carriage/wheels with known pivots and exact envelope; CC0 options were low-poly or single meshes
Cycle 48 → 68 s: every drive keeps its natural physical profile instead of being compressed
Dock-1 staging batch at z 8.9 removed (it sat on the return turn)
Scanned albedo normalised to the app's art-directed colour (variation kept), roughness re-centred, normals as scanned — no baked lighting in albedo
limitations: Still far from the density of generated concepts 01/02 (whole-campus aerials): this is a bounded section; improvement is real but not reference parity
QC night frame changed little compared to build 11; the yard at night is very dark
Workers are static poses (not animated); skin-modifier figures are abstract, faceless
Rear wheels spin from the front-axle odometer (a few % error in tight turns)
Scanned sets have no published physical size except Rubber004/Concrete034; tile sizes estimated
Simulator only: no device FPS/thermal/memory; no TestFlight upload (expired credentials; build number unchanged)
